follow-up time: From 24 weeks of gestation to term
outcome: Maternal blood levels of brain-protein S100B at different time points
Correlation of S100B levels with gestational age and birth weight
finding: Maternal blood levels of brain-protein S100B were higher in GDM pregnancies than controls from 24 weeks of gestation to term, suggesting its potential as an early marker of CNS growth or damage in GDM.
mod_finding: Higher S100B levels were observed in GDM cases delivering vaginally than by caesarean section.
